```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r run-analysis}
gra_result <- driveanalytics::gen_recurrence_analysis(params$df_rdv, params$colm, params$cohort_col)
```

## Results

### Table

A summary table based on `r params$colm`.

```{r table}
driveanalytics::tabulate(gra_result)

```

\pagebreak
### Boxplot

Boxplots of the time between `r params$event_of_interest`  based on `r params$colm`.

```{r plot}
plot.gen_recurrence_analysis(gra_result, params$event_of_interest, params$plot_options)
```
